# Hongkun Wang (王泓坤) — CV

> Digital Development Manager and full-stack engineer based in Shanghai, China. Specializes in TypeScript / React / Next.js, Node.js / FastAPI, and LLM / RAG applications. As the first engineer of Moidas' Greater China division, built the brand's official website, membership & points platform, unified SSO, AI skincare advisor, WeChat AI customer service, brand authorization platform, and two mini-programs from 0 to 1 — 7 core systems within 12 months, backed by 2,100+ automated test cases.

Key facts:

- Languages: Chinese (native), English (CET-4)
- Core skills: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue 3, uni-app, WeChat Mini Program, Canvas 2D, Node.js, FastAPI, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, LLM integration, RAG, Docker, Linux, Nginx, Figma
